content: Yesa Tiofilus:
Nina aba pepa padane madaare neme aba Yesuna pisade kogono-para nipuna agaa-para apo pepa madaa tua repaasude.
Nipuna kogono ripima pa amaa pua so yaa-para penaalo go agaa rayo pepa tua repaasude. Goa pua Yesumi Holi Spirit-na purimi nipuna mapiraasade aposel kogono aanu-para agaa mana lakeloa sone pisa.

Gore aba omenaloa yapi di 40-pela popenaloa aposel kogono aanu raapu epa kiritaawa pirisa. Nimu raapu pirisa rabu nimumi nipu ora pa pia kone inalo oyae adaapu pisa. Goa pua epe kogono radonu pu Gote-na Surube Su madaa agaa adaapu lakesa.
Aposel aanu raapu kirita pirisa rabu Yesumi nimu agaa gupa lakesa: Nimimi Jerusalem suri nagimalepape. Nina Aapame gialiade yae mealiminapa ado piralepape. Go yae madaare neme agaa aba lagisude.
Gore Jon-me onaanu pa ipame baptais meaasa pare wala ogesi-daa pa pirua Holi Spirit-na puri mada baptais mealimina sa.
Aposel aanumi Yesu raapu kiritasimi rabu nipu agaa gupa misimi: Aa Mudu, niaa Israel onaanuri aa-rabu niaame go su-para suruba piralima yapae?
Yesumi lalo: Aapana yapinu nipuna ia-rupa mada na-adema. Aapa nipuna bipa di ia-pulu ni naniminaayo.
Yapare Holi Spirit nimi madaa epenatea rabu puri mealimi-pulu nina pisude remaa Jerusalem su-nane page Judia Samaria lapona apo ipanu popea-nane su rayona laketa pulupape sa.
Yesu yaa-para pisa
Nipumi go agaa loa nimumi adapaba pirina Yesu yaa-para pua moae yako yaa medame nipu mea pua rigitisa.
Yesu so yaa-para pisa rabu aposel kogono aanumi adaba pirina aa laapo nipu raapu rekasipi. Go aa laapona mamina-re yaako pi maraasipi.
Nipu lapome lalo: Galili aanu-ya, akolo yaa-para adaba pimi pae? Go puade Yesuri wala orope go-rupa wala epalia sipi.
Judas-na kogono aa medame minalo mada misimi
Goa pua aposel kogono aanu Rudu Oliv kilipia wala Jerusalem su-para pisimi. Rudu Oliv-ri Jerusalem su-para siti re-paraga gupa wan kilomita-rupa adaalupu aasa.

Jerusalem su-para puare nimuna so ada rum ae-para pua pirisimi. Go pua pirisimi aanuna biri go-rupa: Pita-para Jon-para Jems Andru laapo page Filip Tomas laapo page Bartolomyu Matyu laapo page Jems medare Alfius-na si page Saimon-re nipu Selot-repaa page Juda-re Jems medana si page nimu rayo pirisimi.
Go aanu rayo nimuna kone padane-para sua beten lala pirisimi. Go ona raapu page Yesuna agi ame baaninu page beten lala pirisimi.
Goa pua yapi medaloma pisa rabu kone rulae onaanu kiritasimi. Onaare gupa 120-pela kiritasimi. Go rabu Pita-me rekoa agaa gupa sa:
Ame baaninu, pagalepape. Gote-na pepa madaa Holi Spirit-mi Juda onaanuna kone Devit aba kasa-pulu nipumi pepa madaa tisa. Go Juda-re Yesu gimoa iaanumi tinalo yada robesa.
Goa pisa pare Judas-re ora niaa raapu pirua niaana kogono raba minalo Yesumi Judas mapiraasa.
Yapare go aame yada roboa mone misa. Go mone-mere su meda kaboa orope ope noa lopoa robaa rugulataaboa lo koyapape pua omesa.
Jerusalem su-para piri onaanu pagoa go suna biri Akeldama maasimi. Go bina re aa yaapi i su teme.
Go madaare Buk Sam-para go aa madaa agaa gupa tisimiya: Nipuna ada pa rai aina. Aa medaloma go ada-para mada napirina sa. Goa page tisa: Aa medame nipuna kogono mina sa.
Goa pea-ga abiare niaame aa meda meamina. Go aa nipuri niaa raapu oro yaalo Yesumi agaa mogeasa rabu page niaa pamisima rabu page go rayo ado kiriti aa adoa meamina simi.
Jon-me Yesu baptais mea kasa rabu page Yesu omoa rekoa wala yaa madaa pisa rabu page go rayo ado piri aa meamina simi. Go piane aa mua niaa raapu Yesuna omoa wala rekesa-ga pamu lamina simi.
Pita goa sa rabu aa laapo mada minalo gupa simi: Medare Josep nipuna bi medare Barsabas page Justus page temede. Aa medare nipuna bi Matias teme.
Go rabu beten gupa simi: O Aa Mudu, ne onaa rayona kone ade. Go aa laapo niaame makeme tulalo palima aa neme aa padane mea waalape.
Goa puare go alopatema aame Judas-na kogono mina. Go aa Judas-re nipuna yoto mua ora wae su-para pua simi.
Goa loa nimumi aa laapo adoa Matias madaa raana omesimi. Go aa kogono aa 11-pela raapu aasimi.

footnotes.text: 1.1 Go kogono aanuna buk-ri Luk-mi tua isa. Buk medaa Luk nipuna page tisa. Goa pua nipuna yago medaa Tiofilus piri tua repasa.
